newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WTO chief says telecoms talks "on the right track".
newsitem.headline: WTO chief says telecoms talks "on the right track".

text.p: World Trade Organisation chief Renato Ruggiero said on Friday that talks in Geneva on a global pact to liberalise telecoms trade were "on the right track."

But WTO Director-General Ruggiero declined to say whether a deal would be struck by Saturday's deadline, which some negotiators fear could be missed because of U.S. insistence for better offers from the 61 participating states.
"We are not far from a good result, but it is too early to be certain," he told reporters before a meeting of negotiators to assess state of play in the talks.

Following the meeting of the negotiators, there will be a session of European Union trade and telecommunications ministers to make a final decision on whether Brussels can accept the offers on the table.
European Union Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan told a news conference earlier that he saw no reason for not clinching a deal.
"What is on the table amounts to a massive liberalisation of the world telecommunication market that it would be crazy not to grab with both hands," he said.
"I see no conceivable justification on the basis of what is on the table for failing to clinch the deal," he declared. ((-- Robert Evans, Reuters Geneva Newsroom 41-22-733 38 31))
